text: {character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Tsumo, Riichi Tsumo Pure Double Sequence, Dora... Ah, bull's eye! Two Ura Doras.

{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(Not again?! Three Mangan in a row. She couldn't be cheating with the automated Mahjong machine. Is this... Is this why they say that those at the top of society are blessed with the Midas touch?)
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(Not good... Kaguya will be the dealer next round. If she gets a Mangan Tsumo, or worse, something more than a Mangan, the odds of me making a comeback are basically 0.)

Never in his wildest dreams did Miyuki Shirogane imagine that he'd be pushed to the brink of defeat this early in East Wind round. As his opponent launched a barrage of Tsumo, he is now somehow demotivated.
Kaguya Shinomiya, the kingpin of the social hierarchy... Is it true that this is also reflected in a Mahjong game?
Of course, that's not the case.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Hehe... Is Mr. President still insisting on challenging me head-on? In such a game filled with uncertainties, one can only win if you're not too naive.)

{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(I have 2 and 3 Sou waiting for a sequence, the big winning hand would be All Simples with Mixed Triple Sequence. The player to my left is Hayasaka and she has discarded 4 Sou before, will she discard it again?)
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(What a shame, Mr. President. As long as Hayasaka is taking the seat to your left, you have zero chance of winning.)
{character:Ai Hayasaka}...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Riichi.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}...I'll claw my way back! Shinomiya, I'll declare Follow-up Riichi even though you're the dealer!
{character:Ai Hayasaka}...9 Man.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Dear Hayasaka, it seems like I've achieved Ron with that 9 Man. And with the Riichi of one Han, give me 1,600.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Oh no, my Riichi Mixed Triple Sequence Dora 2...
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Wow, thank goodness I dealt in the Vice President's hand. I'm safe!
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Come on, give up already, Mr. President. I'm doing this for your own good. You should've felt my concern by now.)
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Miss Aihara... Are you... Praying?
{character:Mai Aihara}Yup. I hope that the gods can listen to the clamoring bell and give me a hint of fortune, hehe...
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Wow! That's a cute thought. I couldn't get a winning hand till now. Perhaps you can lend me the bell to change my luck?
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Change the tide by praying? So naive. Mahjong is nothing but a game of probabilities.)
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}I need success this time! Riichi!

{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Darn, I was distracted by that priestess's "assets"... Looks like I have little chance of winning this round with a hand that's 2 tiles from Tenpai. Hayasaka, how are you doing?)
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Coincidentally, the discarded tiles played by Mr. President are the key. It may not be the perfect win with deal-in, but it is what it is.)
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Excuse me, Vice President, I'll take that tile.
{character:Mai Aihara}Ah, I've achieved Ron with that.
Knowing that Kaguya is looking at her, Ai stares at her discarded tiles. With that gesture, Kaguya instantly understands her plan.
Kaguya cheated. Her accomplice is none other than her most trusted maid.

Kaguya is well-aware that her maid has the habit of playing online Mahjong games like Mahjong Soul in her free time. Since she already knows her basics and has a maid's keen eye, she's the perfect accomplice.
{character:Mai Aihara}I must... leave no stone unturned too. Huff-puff!
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Huh? Since when did you achieve Riichi?
{character:Mai Aihara}When the bell was ringing... S-sorry for not having said it louder...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}...Looks like I'm being reckless. Hayasaka has achieved Pinfu with 1 Dora. Looks like you've achieved Riichi, Aihara. Please reveal your Ura Dora.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Looks like I've neglected Miss Aihara by paying too much attention to Mr. President. 2 Red Fives, huh...? I can live with that...)
{character:Mai Aihara}Ah... I've gotten myself 3 Ura Doras.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(What?!)
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}With that Ura Dora, the total will be 12,000 points, plus Hayasaka's 2,000 points. Looks like I'll catch up with Shinomiya in no time! Thanks for the help! Miss Aihara!
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Ah, this is not looking good, Vice...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Let's proceed. Next up, Miss Aihara will be the dealer.
{character:Mai Aihara}Huh? Al... Alright.
Kaguya's right hand gently touches her left cheek, and she gradually becomes emotionless. That's right: her Ice mode has been activated.
The battle of wits on love has now become a pure, heated battle of Mahjong, and the battle continues...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(As a part of the Shinomiya family, I shall take this as a warning and won't lose my composure again!)
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(...Kaguya looks even more serious now. Since my points haven't leveled, I have to be more cautious from now on.)
{character:Ai Hayasaka}(Ah... How troublesome. The desire to get a winning hand burns within me. I'll just fix this craving by playing some Mahjong Soul before bed.)
{character:Mai Aihara}(I wonder if I can get 3 Ura Doras again...)
Kaguya Shinomiya
Miyuki Shirogane
Ai Hayasaka
Mai Aihara
